title: GPReset
description: A Minecraft Reset plugin that Respects Player claim.
body:
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-5865F2?style=flat-square&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/d8TEDxfKwS) [![Source](https://img.shields.io/badge/Source-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/NathanReed-dev/GPReset)
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23472dee4a5160e19c591ef03cbd87ab25df3135_0.webp) **A Paper world-reset plugin that respects player claims.** [![Supports GriefPrevention](https://img.shields.io/badge/Requires-GriefPrevention-red?style=flat-square)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/griefprevention) [![Supports WorldGuard](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supports-WorldGuard-blue?style=flat-square)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldguard)
--- ## Overview GP Reset resets worlds while preserving all active protected land. Before every reset, the current world is automatically backed up. --- ## Supports - **GriefPrevention** — optional - **WorldGuard** — optional --- ## Permissions To run a reset, a player must either be **OP** or have the permission node: ``` gpreset.admin ``` --- ## Backups Each reset saves the current world to a `backups/` folder in the server root. Once the backup count reaches the configured limit, older backups are automatically pruned. --- ## Commands ### `/gpreset reset ` Resets the specified world, preserving all GriefPrevention claims / WorldGuard regions and creating a backup beforehand. ![gpreset world](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Q9Iw8v53/images/b9d79383678324e7584875ef046de43e994dd78d.png) --- ### `/gpreset help` Lists all available commands and usage info. ![gpreset help](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Q9Iw8v53/images/ff26d03e1ec8a11b37347644967d2fd6eb72bdbc.png) --- ### `/gpreset audit ` Detailed Audit on Plugin and World state. ![gpreset preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Q9Iw8v53/images/a555db9e489628135dc8119f56bb14d412dc3374.png) --- ## Configuration (`config.yml`) | Option | Description | |---|---| | `backup-limit` | Max number of backups to keep before pruning old ones | | `timeout` | Seconds a player has to confirm a reset (safety timer) | | `world.blacklist` | List of worlds where the reset command is disabled | | `world.ignore-global-region` | Whether to ignore WorldGuard's global flag during resets |
